Subject: MAP draft (v1) + pricing model — StellarSys pilot

Hi Ari / Maya / Procurement —

Attached is the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (StellarSys_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a companion pricing model (pricing_model_20260312.pdf). Highlights below so Procurement/Legal and your stakeholders can move quickly:

Mutual Action Plan — high level (milestones, owners, dependencies):
- Milestone 1 — Pilot kickoff: Agreement signed, account setup, SOC 2 docs shared. Owner: StellarSys (procurement/legal) + Redwood onboarding. Target date: 2026-03-22. Dependency: Procurement sign-off and NDA.
- Milestone 2 — Pilot deploy & QA: Provisioning, initial fine-tuning with sample KB, latency & accuracy validation. Owner: Redwood Prod Ops + StellarSys Eng. Target date: 2026-04-01. Dependency: Access to KB and test data, VPN/VPC peering if required.
- Milestone 3 — Pilot evaluation & success criteria review: Measure against latency (<300ms median) & accuracy (>85%). Owner: StellarSys Product + Redwood CS. Target date: 2026-04-12.
- Milestone 4 — Contract execution & ramp: Sign full contract, onboarding credits applied, production rollout plan. Owner: StellarSys Procurement + Redwood Sales/Rev Ops. Target close date: 2026-04-15.

Responsibilities (from MAP draft):
- StellarSys: provide test data, procurement/contract sign-off, legal review, internal success criteria sign-off.
- Redwood: provide secured inference endpoints, SOC 2 artifacts, onboarding support, pricing proposal, and a single point of contact for pilot success.

Pricing & approval note (important):
- Proposed list pricing for pilot -> scale path is in pricing_model_20260312.pdf.
- StellarSys requested: 20% one-time onboarding credit ($50k) and a 20% discount on first-year committed spend in exchange for a 12-month, $250k committed ARR.
- Any discount >15% or onboarding credits >$20k require exec approval from Sales Leadership/Rev Ops per Redwood discount policy.

Ask for StellarSys: please confirm that the 12-month commit is feasible on your side (RDW-2026-SS-045). Procurement: confirm any legal milestone timing constraints so we can hit the March/April dates above.

Related links: HubSpot (deal) and a DocuSign envelope will be attached once pricing is confirmed.

Attachments:
- StellarSys_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft)
- pricing_model_20260312.pdf (pricing model, commit tiers and unit economics)

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 15-min call to walk through the MAP and pricing if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MAP draft (v1) + pricing model — StellarSys — request for exec pricing approval

Hi Rishi / Aditya — forwarding the MAP draft and initial pricing ask for quick exec review. Summary & ask below.

Deal: StellarSys (RDW-2026-SS-045)
ARR commit requested: $250,000 (12 months)
Requested concessions: 20% discount on first-year committed spend + $50,000 onboarding credit
Our policy: Discounts >15% or onboarding credits >$20k need explicit approval from Sales Leadership / Rev Ops.

Why we should approve:
- Strategic pilot with quick time-to-value (3 teams, strong expansion signal across ops).
- Competitor risk: they mentioned evaluating other inference providers with similar SLAs.
- Upside: expected expansion into additional teams if pilot success criteria met; projected 3x ARR in 12 months if pilot successful.

Recommended approval options (please state which you sign off on):
1) Approve 20% discount + $50k onboarding credit as requested — requires C-level sign-off (highly favorable to close by 2026-04-15).
2) Approve up to 15% discount + $20k onboarding credit (auto-approvable by Rev Ops) — forces slightly longer negotiation on commit amount.
3) Deny concessions >15% and offer standard onboarding credits ($10k) — we risk elongation and potential loss.

Timeline: StellarSys expects a decision by end-of-day 2026-03-16 to keep target close of 2026-04-15.

Can you please confirm approval choice by 2026-03-16 EOD? If you want, I can pull in VP Sales for faster sign-off.

Thanks,
Marissa
